temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual; when Jose asks if she is okay, she says it is personal stuff and thanks him, but does not share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose has no specific belief that something is wrong with Patricia; he recalls her as usually vibrant and engaged.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Jose now believes Patricia may be dealing with a personal issue and is not ready to talk about it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be troubled by something personal, but she appreciates his concern and is keeping details private.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be available to listen if Patricia wants to talk, without pushing her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments; Patricia later confirms she has been overwhelmed by bills and is open to discussing budgeting.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose suspects Patricia has a personal problem, but he does not know what it is.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Jose now believes at least part of Patricia's distress is financial, and that she may accept help with budgeting or financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is financially stressed and open to discussing financial planning or budgeting when she feels ready.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern, empathy, and a desire to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer practical financial planning or budgeting support and wait for Patricia to indicate when she wants to discuss it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia reassures Jose that he was not prying when he brought up financial planning, and she says she is grateful for his offer to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose worries that he may have overstepped Patricia's boundaries by raising the topic of financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed/resolved: Patricia's reassurance corrects his worry; she does not feel he overstepped and appreciates his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values his concern and help, and Jose can support her as a friend while respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry turning into relief and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Patricia as a friend, respect her privacy, and help if she invites it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says everything is all good and that she plans a quiet weekend at home, without sharing further details; Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers privacy.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his support and may still be open to help, but he remains mindful of not overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed/confirmed: Jose now more strongly believes Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia wants support without pressure and is choosing to manage her personal matters privately.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern and supportive warmth, with some uncertainty about how much to check in.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain a supportive presence without prying, using light check-ins and staying available if she reaches out.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia is busy but says she is handling it; she thanks Jose for checking in and says it is great to have his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates support but prefers privacy and is handling things herself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed: Jose's supportive check-ins are welcome; Patricia is managing her current demands and values his presence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her busy situation and appreciates Jose's non-intrusive support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular friendly check-ins and offer practical help, such as grabbing coffee, without pushing for details.
